title: Jose M Probable NDE 6162
content: I had been really sick. There was blood present in every body secretion and I felt very ill. My parents, however, decided not to take me to the doctor until next day. That night there was a storm outside and I went to bed. Suddenly, it was like I woke up. I was hovering above the room and I could see myself from above at an angle. I could also see the window next to my bed, and the rain and lightning outside. The next thing I knew* I was in a tunnel, which was very dark. I did not touch any of the walls of the tunnel, which seemed to be round. I went through it effortlessly, like floating. I just moved. I could see there was a Light** at the end and I advanced slowly to it, with no fear. After crossing the exit, I was completely surrounded by the Light. I tried to look back to see if the tunnel was still there, but I could not see it. Everywhere I could see was only this Light, which was of a kind I've never seen in this world - it was a white so pure that would be impossible here. I don't have words to describe it. I know I had a conversation with the Light, the content of which I don’t remember. I do remember, however, that the communication was not through sound. I listened to the voice, but it communicated directly putting the concepts of what He wanted to speak directly into my consciousness. I did communicate back to the Light but not by speaking. I just thought of the answers and the Light understood. It was a direct exchange of ideas (so to speak) from one consciousness to another. Of the whole conversation, all I remember is that I was told 'Go back'. Next thing I knew, I woke up. I was on my bed. I sat and looked out of the window. It was still storming, and there was still lightning. * I have to clarify that the whole experience was like by scenes. There was before and after, but the time advanced not as usual. It was more like a series of before and after but with not much of a sense of progression as we have in our regular life. With that in mind, when I say 'next thing I knew' I mean that all around me changed abruptly without a process of change happening. I was in scene one and abruptly switched to scene two. **I use uppercase L for talking about the Light because I know the Light was a personal being. I think the Light was probably God, but I could not tell for sure.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Hovering above the room, seeing self from above at an angle; could see the window next to the bed and the storm (rain and lightning) outside.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Moved effortlessly, 'like floating'; advanced slowly toward the Light.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Experiencer thought the Light was probably God but could not tell for sure.

environment.environment_other_detail: Completely surrounded by Light; 'a white so pure that would be impossible here.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe illness with blood present in every body secretion; went to bed and then the experience occurred during a stormy night.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience described as abrupt 'scenes' with sudden changes rather than continuous progression.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above body/room view → dark tunnel → surrounded by Light and telepathic conversation → told 'Go back' → woke in bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Time/transition described as abrupt scene-switching: 'a series of before and after' without normal sense of progression.
